name: CheckboxGroup
summary: Several related Checkboxes named together by a legend, with an optional hint and one error for the set. Not for one box (use Checkbox alone) or exclusive options (use a radio group). A "select all" parent is a mixed Checkbox at the top of the group whose state the consumer derives from the children.
a11y: A native `fieldset` named by its `legend`, so each box is read with the set's name; the hint and error are linked to the fieldset with `aria-describedby`. The boxes stay in one column in reading order; each row is its own target.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the set, as a question or a noun phrase, with no colon: "Notify me about".

props.name: hint
props.description: One short sentence about the set, such as how many to pick.

props.name: error
props.description: What's wrong with the set and how to fix it: "Choose at least one channel."

props.name: optional
props.description: Marks the legend "(optional)". Sets are required by default, so only optional ones are marked.
